chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Editorâ€™s Foreword Critics appear to agree about two things regarding Ludwig Wittgenstein: he was definitely one of if not the most significant philosophers of the 20th century, and he turned much of what preceded him upside down and strongly influenced much of what followed.
text_raw:
Editorâ€™s Foreword
Critics appear to agree about two things regarding Ludwig Wittgenstein: he
was definitely one of if not the most significant philosophers of the 20th
century, and he turned much of what preceded him upside down and strongly
influenced much of what followed.
